description:
Scan a chain for the newest and most active trading pools, returning name, token_address, price, liquidity, 24h volume and pool age.
For active-pool queries, use listing=trending to select only the original trending listing before the limit. The default mixed view puts new pools first. Inspect pool_age_days, current liquidity and volume; trending, age and one liquidity observation do not establish sustained funding, exit availability or safety.
Discovery only. New pools carry inherently high risk and appearing here is NOT a safety endorsement. Pass assessment_args unchanged to assess_token_risk when present; when absent, do not guess an address or chain. This preserves a chain preference, not a strict chain lock: the engine may report another observed chain. Before using the result for this target, require evidence.chain_searched to match assessment_args.chain_hint. Assessment may select a different primary pool. It does not certify the exact discovered pool or authorize a trade.

chain.description: Chain name, e.g. solana / ethereum / base / bsc

listing.description: mixed scans new then trending; trending scans only that listing.

name: find_new_hot_pools

outputSchema.description: Discovery only, never an endorsement. Use assessment_args when present to preserve the discovered chain preference; do not guess when it is absent. Require returned evidence.chain_searched to match its chain_hint before using the result.

checked_at.description: When this answer was made, ISO-8601 UTC.

count.description: How many pools are in `pools`. NOT how many were examined -- that is `scanned`. This field reported the fetched total beside a shorter list until 2026-09-08, so a caller reading it believed it had seen twenty pools when it had three.

listing.description: Present only for the explicitly selected trending scope; absent for mixed.

network.description: The upstream's own name for the chain, which differs from `chain` (eth vs ethereum).

assessment_args.description: Arguments preserving the selected chain preference, not a strict lock. Omitted for invalid or wrong-family addresses or unsupported networks. Check returned evidence.chain_searched against chain_hint before use.

token_address.description: The base token. Use assessment_args for the chain preference, then verify the returned chain; pool_id is not a token address.

scanned.description: How many distinct pools were examined before the limit was applied. Always >= count.

served_stale.description: Present only when an upstream was unreachable and cached data was used. Each entry names the source and its age in seconds.

sources_failed.description: Which requested listings did NOT answer. Unrequested listings are not failures. A non-empty array means this is a PARTIAL scan: a smaller `scanned` here is a coverage gap, not a quiet market. Treat it as missing information, not as absence.

sources_ok.description: Which of the two upstream listings answered. Both means a full mixed scan. In trending mode only the selected trending listing is requested.

status.description: Completeness only, in the default mixed view: ok means both listings were observed; partial means only one usable listing was observed. This is not a token risk verdict or a safety endorsement. With listing=trending, ok means the selected listing was observed, including an empty list; new is not requested.

title: Find New Hot Pools
